content: Disk maintenance schedule (2026-10-01): weekly scrub Sun 03:30 (btrfs scrub start -B), weekly TRIM Sun 03:00 (/usr/libexec/feralos-weekly-trim: cryptsetup refresh --allow-discards on luks-* -> btrfs filesystem trim -a / -> clear; no luksFormat/booster changes), daily btrbk 02:00; cron paths resolved at install; logrotate 7d for new logs.
